correctness_confidence.basis: All four core theorems and algebraic identities (Pythagorean quadrature defect, two-mode PPT factorization and energy floor, NOPA sub-1-ebit ceiling and exact nu_th cancellation, and diagonally dominant Gaussian chain MI/CMI bounds) check out mathematically. Minor numerical/notational blemishes (e.g., C14 upper bound rounded down from 7.6208e-7 to 7.62e-7, Q = nu/gamma omitting 2*pi, C10 107.5 vs 106.4 pW from rationalizing 2*nu_tilde_- = 0.87, and n_th = 1.66e-5 vs 1.684e-5) do not affect the orders-of-magnitude closure conclusions.

rigor.basis: Exact polynomial factorizations and analytical bounds are clearly derived, and Section 5 honestly delineates the linear NOPA and Gaussian chain verification boundary against non-Gaussian or nonlinear alternatives. Minor rigor gaps include proving Theorem 2 only for the symmetric EPR-form covariance C = diag(c,-c) without formal reduction from arbitrary two-mode covariances, omitting the initial condition nu_tilde_-(0) = 1/4 for C12 in the text/table, and using illustrative dimensionless ratios rather than microscopically derived cristae parameters in Section 4.

novelty.basis: The underlying physical principles (thermal optimality, TMSV energy floor, NOPA 1-ebit steady-state ceiling, entanglement sudden death, and Gaussian Markov CMI decay) are established in quantum optics and continuous-variable quantum information. Novelty resides in casting these bounds into square-root-free polynomial/rational forms suitable for constructive Lean 4 and exact-Q certification and applying them quantitatively to close the 71 THz mitochondrial cristae Gaussian E-track.

significance.basis: Delivers a clear, decisive quantitative resource closure of linear Gaussian entanglement maintenance and long-range Gaussian CMI propagation in the proposed 71 THz mitochondrial polariton regime, showing >974x (and >10.7x at Q=710) power deficits against a 10 pW mitochondrial budget and sub-10 ps entanglement sudden death.

reproducibility.basis: All analytical formulas and certificate parameters (except nu_tilde_-(0) = 1/4 in C12 and exact rational representatives for C10/n_th) can be independently checked from the PDF. However, the referenced Lean 4.36.0 file, exact-Q Python verifier, and SHA-256 certificate manifest are cited only via local relative paths without a public repository URL or inline artifact listing in the manuscript.

summary: This manuscript closes the biology-grade Gaussian E-track for 71 THz mitochondrial cristae polaritons at T = 310 K using exact Gaussian symplectic algebra, linear thermal-bath NOPA dynamics, and Gaussian precision-matrix Schur bounds, stated to be backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems and an AST-audited exact-rational Python certificate suite (C01-C16). Independent checks of the PDF confirm the core identities and orders-of-magnitude impossibility bounds (9.75 nW at 0.5 ebit and gamma = 1 THz; ~107 pW at 0.2 ebit and gamma = 0.1 THz; t_ESD ~ 9.6 ps; exponential MI/CMI suppression across cristae collars). A minor revision is recommended solely to fix a slight upper-bound rounding-down error in C14, state the C12 initial state and C10/n_th rationalizations explicitly, clarify the Q = nu/gamma convention and Section 4 scalar-site / L = d+2 partition assumptions, and provide an externally accessible pointer for the verification artifacts.
strengths: Clean, square-root-free algebraic formulations (Theorem 1 Pythagorean quadrature defect, Theorem 2 PPT polynomial factorization and tight TMSV energy floor, and Theorem 3 exact nu_th cancellation in Eq. (4)) that enable floating-point-free rational verification.

Decisive quantitative resource-boundary closure of steady-state linear NOPA entanglement at 71 THz and 310 K (9,746.4 pW at 0.5 ebit, gamma = 1 THz, exceeding a 10 pW mitochondrial budget by >974x, and >10.7x even at 0.2 ebit, gamma = 0.1 THz) plus sub-10 ps entanglement sudden death upon pump cessation.

Transparent epistemic boundary in Section 5 distinguishing linear Markovian NOPA and Gaussian Markov/evanescent-bypass results from exotic non-Gaussian or nonlinear reservoirs, while explicitly noting that Ref. [4] remains an unrefereed preprint awaiting replication and disclosing operator conflict and AI drafting assistance.
weaknesses: Section 4 models cristae compartments as scalar 1D Gaussian variables (1/2 ln prefactor) with illustrative dimensionless ratios (q = 1/4, 1/2, 2/3; kappa = 1/3, 1/2) rather than deriving collar couplings from microscopic 71 THz polariton electrodynamics or multi-quadrature quantum covariance blocks.

Theorem 2 is formulated strictly for the symmetric EPR-type covariance C = diag(c, -c); while local squeezing only raises energy by Theorem 1, the reduction from general asymmetric two-mode Gaussian covariances is not formally proved in the text.

External verification artifacts (MitoGaussianSymplecticCmiCert.lean, src/mito_gaussian_symplectic_cmi_verifier.py, certificates/MANIFEST.json) are referenced only by local paths rather than a persistent public URL, DOI, or appendix.
potential_errors: Certificate C14 upper bound is reported as I(A:C|B) <= 7.62 x 10^-7 nats (Table 1 and p. 5), whereas evaluating Eq. (7) at epsilon_0/alpha = 1/10, kappa = 1/3, d = 4 gives 1/1,312,198 = 7.62080 x 10^-7 nats; rounding down violates the strict upper bound (it should round up to 7.63 x 10^-7, as done in C13 and C15).

C12 sudden-death interval t_ESD in (9.60, 9.85) ps omits the initial condition nu_tilde_-(0) in both the text around Eq. (5) and Table 1 (the bracket matches nu_tilde_-(0) = 1/4, i.e., 1 ebit, giving 9.62 ps at n_th = 1.66e-5).

Quality factors Q = 71 (gamma = 1 THz) and Q = 710 (gamma = 0.1 THz) at nu = 71 THz use Q = nu/gamma rather than the standard Q = omega/gamma = 2*pi*nu/gamma (which would make Q ~ 446 at gamma = 1 THz, or raise P_maint at true Q = 710 by a factor of 2*pi).

CODATA evaluation of n_th at nu = 71 THz, T = 310 K gives h*nu/(k_B*T) = 10.9918 and n_th = 1.684 x 10^-5 rather than 1.66 x 10^-5 (~1.4% discrepancy), and exact 2*nu_tilde_- = 2^(-0.2) gives P_maint = 106.4 pW for C10 rather than 107.5 pW (consistent with a rationalized 2*nu_tilde_- = 0.87).

In Theorem 4.2, the exact bound |rho_{AC|B}| <= (epsilon_0/alpha)*kappa^d requires A u B u C to exhaust the chain (L = d + 2, implied by 'Partition the chain') and assumes the perturbed precision matrix remains positive definite (not guaranteed solely by epsilon_0 < alpha at small d when beta approaches alpha/2).
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact polynomial factorization of the symmetric two-mode Robertson-Schrodinger and Simon-Peres-Horodecki PPT inequalities yielding the square-root-free entanglement-energy floor (1 - 2*nu_tilde_-)^2 / (8*nu_tilde_-) and exact nu_th cancellation in steady-state NOPA maintenance power, structured for constructive Lean 4 and exact-Q certification.
